annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Offices of the Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Public Security, SAMR, NFRA and ACFTU on Regulating Matters Concerning Traffic Safety Pooling
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 交通运输部办公厅; 公安部办公厅; 市场监管总局办公厅; 金融监管总局办公厅; 中华全国总工会办公厅
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry notice (Dec 2024) regulating "traffic safety pooling", a non-profit mutual aid scheme among transport firms for their own vehicles. It curbs illegal insurance-like operations, mandates inspections and enforcement, and encourages insurers and unions to support road-transport risk prevention. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Traffic safety pooling limited to non-profit mutual aid for a firm's own vehicles; no offering to unspecified vehicles
Firms may not use 'motor vehicle pooling' terms in names or business scope
Authorities must investigate and crack down on illegal operations posing as pooling
Insurers barred from cooperating with non-licensed pooling operators
Encourages insurer participation in accident prevention and worker mutual aid
